name: devflow-ai
description: DevFlow AI — IBM Bob Hackathon 2.0 — AI-powered developer release-readiness workflow assistant

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix sample-project install
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build

comment:dependencies: cors and express are hoisted here on purpose. api/index.js requires ../backend/src/server, and Vercel builds that function from the repository root. Node resolves those imports by walking up from backend/src, so backend/node_modules would work, but only if a root-level install had already created it. Declaring them at the root means a bare 'npm install' provisions the function even when the project's Install Command is left at its default. Versions match backend/package.json; keep the two in step. The backend used to also depend on uuid, which is ESM-only and therefore unloadable from CommonJS on Node older than 22.12; identifiers now come from node:crypto via backend/src/ids.js, so no ESM dependency is reachable from the function bundle.
